Pico POS

Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 14, 2026

At Pico POS (developed by Himpower Pvt. Ltd.), we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the operational data of your business and the personal information of your operators. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, process, secure, and disclose information when you use our application, whether on the web or as an app downloaded from the App Store or Google Play.

1. Information We Collect

Pico POS handles two main categories of information:

  • Account information: email address (for sign-in), business name, location, currency, tax identifiers, and settlement account details you choose to enter.
  • Transactional & POS data: table configurations, menu items, sales records, receipt history, order statuses, and performance statistics — used solely to run your dashboard, generate analytics, and support your daily business operations.

2. How Sign-In Works

You sign in with an email and password, or with your Google account. Sign-in is handled by Firebase Authentication (a Google Cloud service); we never see or store your password. Each store's data is kept completely separate and accessible only to that store's signed-in owner.

3. Subscriptions & Payment

Subscription purchases made through the iOS or Android app are processed entirely by the Apple App Store or Google Play, using RevenueCat to manage subscription status. We never see or store your card details — payment is handled directly by Apple/Google's own secure checkout. RevenueCat receives only your subscription status (active plan, renewal date) to keep your account in sync.

4. Offline-First & Data Storage

Pico POS features an offline-capable, cloud-synchronized architecture. Your transactional records are cached locally on your device so billing keeps working during network outages, and synchronized with our cloud servers (Google Firebase / Firestore) when you're online, to protect against data loss if your device is lost or damaged.

5. How We Use and Share Your Data

We do not sell, rent, trade, or distribute your transactional records or sales insights to any third parties. We only process this data to:

  • Provide core point-of-sale functionality, cloud backups, and transaction history.
  • Power optional AI business insights (e.g. sales forecasting) via a third-party language model provider.
  • Process subscription payments through Apple, Google, and RevenueCat as described above.
  • Comply with valid legal or regulatory requests.

The third-party services we rely on to operate Pico POS are: Google Firebase (hosting, database, authentication), RevenueCat (subscription management), and Apple/Google (app distribution and payment processing).

6. Data Retention & Deletion

We retain your account and transaction data for as long as your account is active, so you retain access to your sales history. To request deletion of your account and associated data, email us at the address below — we will process deletion requests within 30 days, except where we're required to retain records for legal or tax compliance purposes.

7. Security

We use HTTPS encryption for all data in transit and server-side encryption at rest. Because some data is cached on your device, you're responsible for restricting physical and digital access to your POS terminals.

8. Children's Privacy

Pico POS is business software intended for use by adult store operators and staff. It is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13.

9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by the "Last updated" date above.
